questions.def: 'Whether' introduces a noun clause expressing doubt or a question.
questions.question: ___ the data supports the hypothesis is still under investigation.

questions.def: 'How' indicates the manner in which the restructuring will occur.
questions.question: The report clarifies ___ the company's restructuring will proceed.

questions.def: 'Whether' is used here to introduce a noun clause of doubt.
questions.question: ___ he is innocent remains to be seen.

questions.def: 'That' introduces a noun clause stating a fact or assertion.
questions.question: ___ the experiment failed is less important than why it failed.

questions.def: 'That' introduces a noun clause acting as the object of 'confirmed'.
questions.question: The board confirmed ___ the merger had been finalized.

questions.def: 'That' introduces a noun clause after adjectives like 'crucial'.
questions.question: It is crucial ___ they reach a consensus.

questions.def: 'Whether' indicates a doubt or alternative regarding the effect.
questions.question: It is unclear ___ the new policy will affect employee morale.

questions.def: 'What' is used to ask about something unknown.
questions.question: The researcher investigated ___ caused the sudden market crash.

questions.def: 'That' indicates a fact or assertion.
questions.question: ___ he understood the complexities was evident.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces a noun clause expressing an option.
questions.question: ___ he chooses to resign is entirely his prerogative.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect question indicating doubt.
questions.question: She asked ___ the data was collected ethically.

questions.def: 'That' would be more correct as 'That's what surprised everyone...'.
questions.question: What surprised everyone is that he admitted guilt.

questions.def: 'That' introduces a noun clause after impersonal constructions.
questions.question: It is important ___ the facts are accurate.

questions.def: 'Whether' expresses doubt about the approval.
questions.question: ___ the committee will approve the proposal is uncertain.

questions.def: 'How' indicates the manner of misappropriation.
questions.question: The investigation revealed ___ the funds were misappropriated.

questions.def: 'Whether' signals uncertainty or doubt.
questions.question: ___ the artifact was genuine baffled experts.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces a noun clause expressing a choice.
questions.question: ___ she intends to pursue further studies is her decision.

questions.def: 'How' describes the method used.
questions.question: The scientist explained ___ the experiment was conducted.

questions.def: 'That' introduces a noun clause specifying the news.
questions.question: The news ___ the treaty was ratified was welcomed.

questions.def: 'Whether' indicates doubt about the implementation.
questions.question: It remains to be seen ___ the proposed changes will be implemented.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a noun clause specifying the influences.
questions.question: The professor investigated ___ influenced the author's writing.

questions.def: 'Whether' indicates uncertainty.
questions.question: ___ he committed the crime is still a mystery.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces a clause expressing doubt.
questions.question: ___ the research methodology was sound is questionable.

questions.def: 'How' describes the manner of implementation.
questions.question: The committee discussed ___ the new regulations should be implemented.

questions.def: "Whether" introduces a noun clause expressing doubt or uncertainty.
questions.question: ___ he will attend the meeting remains uncertain.

questions.def: "That the" introduces a noun clause acting as the object of "decided."
questions.question: The committee decided ___ evidence was insufficient.

questions.def: "What is believed" is a noun clause functioning as the subject.
questions.question: ___ is not always the truth.

questions.def: "What" introduces a noun clause serving as the object of "unsure."
questions.question: I am unsure ___ caused the error in the system.

questions.def: "What" introduces a noun clause acting as the object of "confirms."
questions.question: The report confirms ___ the researchers suspected.

questions.def: "Decide what" needs to be done forms the object of the sentence.
questions.question: The court will ___ is just.
